UserCloudAccount.title: UserCloudAccount
UserCloudAccount.description: Root cloud workspace document for a signed-in user owning media source bookmarks.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud workspace was last updated.

AudiusProfileItem.title: AudiusProfileItem
AudiusProfileItem.description: Saved Audius artist/profile handle synced to cloud.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

handle.description: Normalized Audius profile handle without leading @.

isActive.description: Whether this profile was active when synced.

UrlSourceItem.title: UrlSourceItem
UrlSourceItem.description: Saved URL, radio stream, or repository music source synced to cloud.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

url.description: Normalized source URL or multi-line URL playlist.

label.description: Display label for the URL source.

isActive.description: Whether this URL source was active when synced.

addedAt.description: Client epoch milliseconds timestamp when added.

FolderBookmarkItem.title: FolderBookmarkItem
FolderBookmarkItem.description: Metadata bookmark for a local device folder (actual media files & handles stay local in IndexedDB).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

name.description: Display name of the local folder or file collection.

trackCount.description: Number of media items in the folder.

addedAt.description: Client epoch milliseconds timestamp when added.

TrackPlayStat.title: TrackPlayStat
TrackPlayStat.description: Shared aggregate play counter in the YRitmX player for an Audius track.

trackId.description: Normalized Audius track document identifier (e.g. audius-75g5N).

playerPlays.description: Total active listens (>15s) recorded across all YRitmX player users.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest recorded listen.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user root cloud document serving as the relational master gate for media source subcollections.

/users/{userId}/audiusProfiles/{profileI.description: User-saved Audius artist handles synced across devices.

/users/{userId}/urlSources/{urlId}.description: User-saved radio stream and URL repository sources synced across devices.

/users/{userId}/folderBookmarks/{folderI.description: Lightweight metadata bookmarks of user local folders.

/trackStats/{trackId}.description: Shared per-track play counter incremented by +1 after 15+ seconds of active playback.
